ag.cevrimdisiBaslik: The device appears to be offline
ag.cevrimdisiMetin: The device is registered but is not responding. Make sure it is on and connected to the internet; remote access may also have been turned off from the device's own screen.
ag.farkliAgBaslik: You are on a different network
ag.farkliAgMetin: Your phone is not on the same Wi-Fi as the device. This is normal — the pairing code below is exactly for this; you connect to the device over the internet.
ag.izolasyonBaslik: Your modem is isolating devices from each other
ag.izolasyonMetin: The device can be reached over the internet, but not directly on the same Wi-Fi ({{cihazIp}}). "Client isolation" (AP Isolation) may be enabled on your modem, or your phone may be on a guest network. Turn this option off in the modem settings or move your phone to the main Wi-Fi network. If you prefer, you can also connect over the internet with the code below.

altBaslik: App preferences and device connection settings.

baglanti.agdaYok: ⚠️ No PEMF device found on the network. Make sure you are on the same WiFi as the device, or enter the IP manually.
baglanti.bagliBuSayfa: ✅ Connected to the server (this page's server).
baglanti.cihazYok: ❌ No PEMF device was found at this address.
baglanti.manuelAciklama: Manual fallback: IP on the same Wi-Fi (192.168.x.x:8000), tunnel link on a different network (https://...trycloudflare.com).
baglanti.taramaBasarisiz: ⚠️ Scan failed. Enter the device IP manually.

bakim.aciklama: Use only in emergencies or when the system locks up.
bakim.pwmGovde: The output of all coils will be reset. Any session in progress will be INTERRUPTED.
bakim.pwmSifirlandi: All coil PWM signals were reset.
bakim.selfTestGonderildi: Self-test command sent to the hardware.
bakim.selfTestGovde: The device will test itself; the coils may be energized briefly during the test. Make sure the animal is NOT in the cabin.

bulut.guncellenemiyor: The device's cloud record cannot be updated right now (network or server error). Remote access information may be outdated; if the problem persists, tell the support team.
bulut.istemciYok: Cloud connection was not established: the device is not registering for remote access. Connections on the same network are not affected.
bulut.rpcEksik: The cloud record is being written with an incomplete configuration: the pairing code is not sent to the cloud, so connecting remotely with the code will not work. Connections on the same network are not affected.
bulut.secretUyusmazligi: Remote access is not updating: this device's identity is registered in the cloud with a different security key (usually happens after a reinstall). The pairing code below will NOT work for connecting remotely. Connections on the same network are not affected. Ask the support team to reset the device's cloud record.

dil.aciklama: App language. Your choice is remembered on this device and does not depend on your account or profile.
dil.kayitHatasi: The language choice could not be saved on this device. The device language will be used when the app reopens.

eslestirme.kimlikYalnizBagliyken: This device's pairing ID is shown only while connected to the device.
eslestirme.paylasin: To open this device remotely, share the identity below with another device.

sonuc.adresYok: The device was found but has no remote access address. If the device is on and remote access is enabled, check the cloud record warning on the device's Settings screen.
sonuc.adresYokBayat_one: The device is registered but has no remote access address, and its cloud record has not been updated for {{count}} day. This usually means the device cannot write to the cloud (even if the device is on). Check the warning on the device's Settings screen; if the problem persists, tell the support team.
sonuc.adresYokBayat_other: The device is registered but has no remote access address, and its cloud record has not been updated for {{count}} days. This usually means the device cannot write to the cloud (even if the device is on). Check the warning on the device's Settings screen; if the problem persists, tell the support team.
sonuc.bayat: The device is registered but appears to be offline right now. Make sure it is on and connected to the internet.
sonuc.bulunamadi: No online device matches this code/ID. You also get this message if the device has been off/offline for a long time: first make sure the device is on and connected to the internet, then check the code.
sonuc.bulutaUlasilamadi: Could not reach the cloud (connection/timeout). Check your internet and try again.
sonuc.jetonYok: The device was found but no access key could be obtained — not connected. Try again while on the same Wi-Fi network as the device, or enter the pairing code shown on the device screen.
sonuc.jetonYokOnceki: The device was found but no access key could be obtained — the connection stayed on the previous device. Try again while on the same Wi-Fi network as the device, or enter the pairing code shown on the device screen.
sonuc.kodReddi: The pairing code was not accepted. The connection setting was not changed; check the code and try again.
sonuc.kodReddiOnceki: The device was found but the pairing code was not accepted — the connection stayed on the previous device. Check the code and try again.
sonuc.ulasilamiyor: The device was found but is offline right now, or its identity could not be verified.

eslestirme.uzakBaglanBaslik: Connect to a remote device (code or ID)
eslestirme.uzakBaglanEtiketi: Connect to a remote device: pairing code or device ID
eslestirme.uzakBaglanIpucu: Pairing code (e.g. A3F9K2) or device ID

eslestirmeRehberi.ayniWifi: Are you on the same Wi-Fi?
eslestirmeRehberi.ayniWifiKodGerekmez: If you connect to the same Wi-Fi as the device, no code is needed; the app finds the device by itself.
eslestirmeRehberi.birKezEslesme: Once paired, this screen won't appear again — the app connects automatically on later launches.
eslestirmeRehberi.bulunamadi: Device not found. This is normal if your phone is <kalin>not on the same Wi-Fi as the device</kalin> (mobile data or another network).
eslestirmeRehberi.ekranAciklama: In the PEMF Vet app, the <kalin>6-character pairing code</kalin> appears under <kalin>Settings → Remote Access Connection</kalin>.
eslestirmeRehberi.farkliAg: if you're on a different network
eslestirmeRehberi.gecici: If the connection dropped briefly, searching again is enough — no code needed.
eslestirmeRehberi.kimlikIpucu: You can also paste the device ID instead of the code (longer than {{max}} characters).

gelistiriciModulleri.aciklama: When on, developers' control modules can be selected in the Control tab. Keep this off in the product as sold. EMERGENCY STOP always stops running modules too.
gelistiriciModulleri.hata: The setting could not be saved — try again.

hesap.adSoyadBos: First and last name cannot be empty.
hesap.epostaAciklama: Email is the account identity and cannot be changed. You can update the other details with "Edit".

kabinKamerasi.aciklama: The camera that sees the cabin for analysis (Take Photo, Live Camera) and AI Pro. Your choice is remembered on this device; the camera opens at its highest resolution (at the cabin calibration's resolution if one exists).
kabinKamerasi.bulunamadi: No camera was found on this computer. Check the camera cable and scan again.
kabinKamerasi.seciliKameraAdli: Selected camera: {{ad}} ({{vidpid}}) — currently camera {{indeks}}; this camera opens even if the order changes
kabinKamerasi.seciliKameraBagliDegil: Selected camera: {{ad}} ({{vidpid}}) — NOT CONNECTED. Plug it into USB, or use "Scan for cameras" to select it again.
kabinKamerasi.secilmedi: No cabin camera selected — photos, the live camera and AI Pro cannot open the cabin camera. Scan the cameras and choose the one that shows the cabin.
kabinKamerasi.taramaZamanAsimi: The camera scan did not finish in time — the cameras did not respond while opening. Check the camera cable, close any other app that is using the camera (e.g., Windows Camera) and scan again.
kabinKamerasi.taraniyor: Opening the cameras — this may take a few seconds.

saklama.anonimBekleyen_one: {{count}} patient with no session for {{gun}} days (5 years) is waiting for anonymization. This action CANNOT BE UNDONE: the patient's name, the owner's name and contact details, age and weight, and the name in session and AI records are permanently deleted; treatment data and the veterinarian's name remain. No record is touched until you approve.
saklama.anonimBekleyen_other: {{count}} patients with no session for {{gun}} days (5 years) are waiting for anonymization. This action CANNOT BE UNDONE: the patient's name, the owner's name and contact details, age and weight, and the name in session and AI records are permanently deleted; treatment data and the veterinarian's name remain. No record is touched until you approve.
saklama.anonimOkunamadi: The number of patients waiting for anonymization could not be read — check the patient database. No record is touched without approval.
saklama.anonimOnayEtiketi: Confirm and start the irreversible anonymization
saklama.anonimOnayli: Anonymization approved — patients with no session for {{gun}} days (5 years) are anonymized automatically.
saklama.bekleyenOkunamadi: The number of session records waiting to be masked could not be read — check the treatment database. Approval cannot be given without seeing the number; no record is touched until approval.
saklama.kapali: Masking OFF — patient and operator names in session records are not masked when a period ends.
saklama.kapaliAnonim: Patients with no session for {{gun}} days (5 years) have their identity details anonymized only with your approval; the veterinarian's name remains.
saklama.kapsam: The retention period applies to ALL session records on this device (clinical and research).
saklama.maskeBekleyen_one: {{count}} session record is waiting to be masked under the {{gun}}-day period. This action CANNOT BE UNDONE: patient names are permanently deleted. No record is touched until you approve.
saklama.maskeBekleyen_other: {{count}} session records are waiting to be masked under the {{gun}}-day period. This action CANNOT BE UNDONE: patient names are permanently deleted. No record is touched until you approve.
saklama.maskeOnayEtiketi: Confirm and start the irreversible masking
saklama.maskelenir: Patient and operator names in session records are permanently masked after {{gun}} days ([REDACTED]). Treatment data (dose, duration, sensor) REMAINS.
saklama.onayBekliyor: Masking is waiting for your approval: no session record is masked without approval. If you approve, patient and operator names in records older than {{gun}} days are permanently masked ([REDACTED]); treatment data (dose, duration, sensor) REMAINS.
saklama.oncekiOnayEski: The previous approval does not record which period it was given for (old version); a new approval is required.
saklama.oncekiOnaySure: The previous approval was for a {{gun}}-day period; a new approval is required because the period or the masking scope changed.
saklama.saatOnay: The clock is correct, continue retention
saklama.saatOnayEtiketi: Confirm that the device clock is correct
saklama.saatSupheli: The device clock is suspect ({{saat}}). Until the clock is verified, masking, anonymization and deletion of expired records are NOT DONE; no data is lost, it only waits. First correct the device's date and time. If the clock was behind for a while, records written during that time appear with older dates and are processed according to the retention period after approval.

uzakErisim.aciklama:
The device connects AUTOMATICALLY — you do not need to enter an IP.
📡 Same Wi-Fi → found instantly via mDNS.
🌐 Different network → after pairing once, it connects automatically to the device's current address in the cloud.
The options below are only a MANUAL fallback if the automatic connection fails.

veriTasima.aciklama: Patient records, session history and AI analysis history are exported to a single ENCRYPTED file.
veriTasima.aciklamaArastirma: ALL records on this device — clinical and research: patient / subject cards, session history and AI analysis history — are exported to a single ENCRYPTED file.
veriTasima.disaAgHatasi: Connection lost — the backup did not reach this device; consider the backup NOT CREATED. Check the connection and take the backup again.
veriTasima.disaAktarEtiketi: Export clinical data to an encrypted file
veriTasima.disaAktarEtiketiArastirma: Export all records on this device to an encrypted file
veriTasima.disaZamanAsimi: The backup may still be running on the device — the device did not respond in time (the data may be large). Wait a while and check whether the backup file has been created.
veriTasima.geriYukleUyari: Restoring DELETES the existing session and analysis history if there are records on this device. Patient cards are not deleted.
veriTasima.geriYukleUyariArastirma: Restoring DELETES the existing session and analysis history (clinical and research) if there are records on this device. Patient / subject cards are not deleted.
veriTasima.iceAgHatasi: Connection lost — the restore may have started on the device. Do not repeat the operation; once the connection returns, refresh Session History after a few minutes.
veriTasima.iceZamanAsimi: The restore may still be running on the device — your records will appear when it finishes. Do not repeat the operation or restart the app; refresh Session History in a few minutes.
veriTasima.parolaUyarisi: It is restored on the new computer with the same password. The file cannot be opened without the password — if you lose the password, the backup cannot be recovered.

yedek.geriYukleOnay:
If there are records on this device, the existing treatment history (sessions, coil runs, sensor data, AI analyses) will be DELETED and replaced with the backup. Patient cards are not deleted: cards of patients not in the backup remain, but their session history on this device is deleted.

Continue?
yedek.icerikYok: The backup could not be made — the device did not return the file content.
yedek.indirmeBasladi: Download started: {{dosyaAdi}} ({{sayim}}). Check that the file arrived in your downloads folder — the browser may have blocked the download.
yedek.kaydedilemedi: The backup file could not be saved.
yedek.okunamadi: The backup file could not be read — select the file again; the restore did NOT START.
yedek.yolYok: The backup file could not be saved — the device did not report the file path; consider the backup NOT CREATED.

yedekParola.belirleAciklama: Without this passphrase the backup file CANNOT be opened or recovered. It must be at least {{min}} characters; save it in a password manager.
yedekParola.girAciklama: Enter the passphrase you set when the backup was created.
